gen-gf-gugi-gf-mozilla-headline: Gugi shouts in tall, open-mouthed lowercase that nearly touches its capitals. Mozilla Headline is plain sans with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, so paragraph after paragraph feels approachable and contemporary.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-mozilla-text: Distinctive and bold, Gugi stretches its lowercase nearly to cap height, with curves that match its stems exactly. Mozilla Text, plain sans with flaring terminals, gives that voice somewhere to settle.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans keeps a large central band in the text line, with curved letters whose mouths stay wide and unclosed. And the technical-pen steadiness keeps running text feeling clean and contemporary under Gugi's bolder heading.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-nobile: Gugi is all display attitude, tall in the lowercase and without a single hairline anywhere. Nobile, plain sans with barely any gap between lowercase and capitals, carries running text in a contemporary, businesslike way.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-nokora: Gugi draws bold, tall lowercase and diagonals that match its stems exactly. Nokora, plain sans with an s that never tightens, is the pair's best trait: a dark, approachable stripe of text.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic reads modern and clean, with a welcoming gap in the c and capitals barely above lowercase. But Gugi's steady, unshaded outlines and tall, bold lowercase give each heading enough presence to lead the text below.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Clean and contemporary, Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart. The shared stature is the pair's best quality: Gugi's lowercase nearly reaches the capitals, while c, s and z here stand tall and full.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoined: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined gives its curves generous room beside the stem. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined, plain sans with little height difference between cases, keeps running text smooth and modern beneath Gugi's tall bold heads.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hiero: Gugi holds its strokes with the steadiness of a drawn string, lowercase rising nearly to the capitals. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs, a modern sans with outward-pointing terminals, rises almost as tall, so both share one skyline.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-arabic: A plain stripe of constant ink runs through Gugi, with tall lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. And Noto Sans Arabic, with its pronounced x-height and wide openings, holds up fine a notch smaller than the heading.
